description: Shared Renovate preset for the managed universe. Repositories extend this and add nothing else unless they must.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A security fix does not wait for the weekly window. Renovate already prioritises these; the schedule override is what lets them out.

customManagers.description: standards/security.md embeds a pinned gitleaks version and checksum in every repository's workflow. Without this, twelve copies go stale together and nothing notices.

packageRules.description: Pin by digest. deploys needs immutable references, and so does every image this universe builds on.
Group non-major updates so a quiet week is one pull request, not nine.
A major update is reviewed on its own.
GitHub Actions are pinned to a commit SHA by standards/security.md. Keep the version comment true when the SHA moves.
TypeScript has a peer-dependency range in typescript-eslint. See standards/languages/typescript.md.
